plugin_realname.title: ID Verification
plugin_realname.description: Free basic ID-card capability: format validation of mainland resident ID numbers with region, birthday and sex parsing, optional two-element name/number verification (provider off by default), and a verification ledger that keeps only digests and masked values.
plugin_realname.name: Name
plugin_realname.parseIdle: Fill in the name and ID number, then use Check format only or submit; region, birthday and sex appear here.
plugin_realname.legacyHint: A 15-digit legacy number, upgraded to 18 digits. Legacy numbers carry no check digit of their own.
plugin_realname.historicalHint: This region code has been retired (county-to-district changes and similar); it is shown with its historical name.
plugin_realname.ledgerHint: The ledger stores only masked name/number values plus a sha256 digest of the number; plaintext is never written to the database.
plugin_realname.doneOffline: Online verification is off: only the format verdict was recorded
plugin_realname.enabledHint: Each verification then calls a paid external service. Saving requires a provider, an https endpoint and a credential.
plugin_realname.secretHint: Leave empty to keep the stored secret. Secrets stay server-side; the API only reports whether one exists.
plugin_realname.searchPlaceholder: Search a name or number fragment
plugin_realname.empty: No verification yet. Submit one above and it is recorded here.

reason.birthday_future: Birth date is in the future
reason.checksum: Check digit mismatch, usually one mistyped digit

plugin_realname.regionCoarseHint: Region resolved only to {level}: the division snapshot is coarser or the county was reorganized. It does not affect the validity verdict.
